# sd-release tests (docs/design/04 §9.3, §12.3; TM-R38): the tool end to end with TEST keys generated by the script
# (release_flow.cmake). CTest label release. Nothing here uses or stores a release key.
add_test(NAME release.flow
         COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" "-DSD_RELEASE=$<TARGET_FILE:sd-release>"
                 "-DWORK=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests/release/work"
                 -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/release_flow.cmake")
set_tests_properties(release.flow PROPERTIES LABELS release TIMEOUT 300)

# Release gates record (04 §12.3, r21): gates check verdicts and sign refusals.
add_test(NAME release.gates
         COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" "-DSD_RELEASE=$<TARGET_FILE:sd-release>"
                 "-DWORK=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests/release/gates"
                 -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gates_flow.cmake")
set_tests_properties(release.gates PROPERTIES LABELS release TIMEOUT 300)

# Compiled-in keyring (04 §9.3): keyring generates the stub keyring and the host trust from TEST keys, refused
# keysets and malformed roots.txt included.
add_test(NAME release.keyring
         COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" "-DSD_RELEASE=$<TARGET_FILE:sd-release>"
                 "-DSD_UPDSIGN=$<TARGET_FILE:sd-updsign>"
                 "-DWORK=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests/release/keyring"
                 -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/keyring_flow.cmake")
set_tests_properties(release.keyring PROPERTIES LABELS release TIMEOUT 300)

# dokany.lock verification (04 §7.3, TM-R23): the strict lock parser and the file checks, with fake upstream files.
add_test(NAME release.dokany
         COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" "-DSD_RELEASE=$<TARGET_FILE:sd-release>"
                 "-DWORK=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests/release/dokany"
                 -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/dokany_flow.cmake")
set_tests_properties(release.dokany PROPERTIES LABELS release TIMEOUT 300)
